about.p1: Architecting Scalable Intelligence. I am a builder at heart. My approach to technology is grounded in a sociable and optimistic nature, believing that the best solutions come from open dialogue and teamwork. With a solid foundation in Computer Science from La Sapienza University (graduating with 110/110 Cum Laude), I have always sought to understand how things work to make them work better.
about.p2: My background bridges two worlds: the rigorous standards of enterprise IT consulting and the agile innovation of the startup ecosystem. Today, as Co-Founder of 4AI, I design the architectures that power our vision, ensuring that our AI models run on robust, scalable, and efficient full-stack systems.
about.p3: I am driven by the challenge of connecting academic research with real-world applications.

gesture.subtitle: Hand gesture understanding for deception detection and real-time ASL digit recognition.
gesture.description:
Designed and trained recurrent neural models to detect deception from hand-gesture dynamics in video datasets, as part of my B.Sc. thesis at Sapienza University.

Built a real-time computer-vision system for recognizing ASL digits (0–9) through hand-gesture analysis, combining neural networks with live video inference.

about.p1: Il mio viaggio nella tecnologia è iniziato nell'adolescenza, alimentato dalla curiosità di costruire siti web e sperimentare col design. Quella scintilla mi ha portato al percorso in Informatica presso La Sapienza Università di Roma, dove mi sono laureato con il massimo dei voti (110/110 e Lode).
about.p2: Oggi, come Co-Founder di 4AI, colmo il divario tra ricerca accademica e software pronto per la produzione. Non scrivo solo codice; architetto sistemi. Che si tratti di Deep Learning, Computer Vision o Data Engineering, il mio obiettivo è trasformare concetti avanzati in piattaforme innovative e utilizzabili.
about.p3: Prospero in ambienti dinamici dove la precisione tecnica incontra il problem-solving creativo.
